description: Source code for rio.c, a stream-oriented I/O abstraction layer used in Redis for flexible input/output operations across different devices and buffers, including buffer, file, and socket-based I/O implementations.

methods.name: rioBufferWrite
methods.description: Writes data to a buffer-based rio object, appending data to the internal sds buffer.

methods.name: rioBufferRead
methods.description: Reads data from a buffer-based rio object, copying data from the internal buffer if enough data is available.

methods.name: rioBufferTell
methods.description: Returns the current read/write position in the buffer.

methods.name: rioBufferFlush
methods.description: Flushes the buffer, which is a no-op for buffer-based rio objects.

methods.name: rioInitWithBuffer
methods.description: Initializes a rio object with a given sds buffer for buffer-based I/O.

methods.name: rioFileWrite
methods.description: Writes data to a file stream, with optional autosync based on autosync setting.

methods.name: rioFileRead
methods.description: Reads data from a file stream.

methods.name: rioFileTell
methods.description: Returns the current position in the file stream.

methods.name: rioFileFlush
methods.description: Flushes the file stream.

methods.name: rioInitWithFile
methods.description: Initializes a rio object with a FILE pointer for file-based I/O.

methods.name: rioFdsetWrite
methods.description: Writes data to multiple file descriptors, handling partial writes and errors.

methods.name: rioFdsetRead
methods.description: Read operation not supported for fdset rio objects.

methods.name: rioFdsetTell
methods.description: Returns the current position in the fdset rio object.

methods.name: rioFdsetFlush
methods.description: Flushes the fdset buffer, triggering write of buffered data.

methods.name: rioInitWithFdset
methods.description: Initializes a rio object with multiple file descriptors for output.

methods.name: rioFreeFdset
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an fdset rio object.

methods.name: rioGenericUpdateChecksum
methods.description: Updates the checksum of data using crc64.

methods.name: rioSetAutoSync
methods.description: Configures automatic fsync after a specified number of bytes written.

methods.name: rioWriteBulkCount
methods.description: Writes a Redis protocol multi-bulk count.

methods.name: rioWriteBulkString
methods.description: Writes a binary-safe string in Redis protocol format.

methods.name: rioWriteBulkLongLong
methods.description: Writes a long long value in Redis bulk string format.

methods.name: rioWriteBulkDouble
methods.description: Writes a double value in Redis bulk string format.
